input.role: sole primary-approved exact-activity full apricot mother; lighting-weather edit only

prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather. One complete 1536 x 1024 same-room themed mother.
The ONLY INPUT image 1 is the PRIMARY-APPROVED APRICOT MOTHER FOR THIS EXACT ACTIVITY. It is the full edit target, not a reference portrait. Relight it as a whole; do not recompose or create a new pose.
LOCK source geometry, face/age/hair, expression/gaze, body proportions, exact hands/fingers/feet and support contacts, clothing folds, all props/held items, empty shoes, chair orientation, desk width/lamp/cup position, bench/pillows/throw, all window frame corners and continuous architecture, distant campus landmarks, rear-left table/shelves/drawing, rug and floorboards. No crop/zoom/enlargement, body relocation, anatomy completion, chair restoration from another room or furniture drift. The provided activity silhouette stays unchanged, including all fine hair/prop/shoe tips inside the same full canvas.
This is MISUMI UIKA (三角初華): the same youthful short chin-length pale-blonde bob with a faint pink undertone, violet eyes, white T-shirt, long taupe-gray skirt and original socks/footwear arrangement in this approved input. Do not substitute an adult, long brown hair or another girl. Her original outfit and object colors remain material colors under new light.
Relight the whole person AND room together: exterior/sky/water/glass, lamp, walls/wood/linen, hair/skin/clothes/objects and contact shadows must agree. Natural skin, readable eyes/hands, real cloth/wood colors. No flat color filter, uniform orange/purple wash, black overlay, green cast, white gradient, pasted bright face, blank wall, split day/night, extra light source, new prop/person or background replacement. Fine youthful anime linework and the same softly detailed painted environment. No text/UI/logos/watermarks/arrows/borders/insets.

SOURCE ACTIVITY ATTENTION: preserve the approved gentle forward torso turn and short reach offering the same thin ivory bookmark, the other palm supporting on the bench, source face/gaze and grounded sneakers. Do not turn it into a wave/chat pose, change the held paper shape or move the hand into the central reading lane.

THEME MIST: clear blue-white morning and light low haze over the SAME distant lake/campus. Haze stays outside. Broad diffuse cool window daylight, softened apricot sun/leaf streaks, ivory wall and honey wood still natural, neutral linen. Existing desk lamp OFF, fixture unchanged. Subtle cool rim/neutral fill on the person, original skin/hair/clothing hues; no icy cyan skin, blue clothing dye, gray room or indoor fog. Keep the left living detail and complete room readable.
Return ONE complete exact-size scene with source composition and anatomy unchanged.
